method: Root manual unblinded inspection of every complete immutable endpoint patch, exact public APIs, delivered tests, command chronology and delivery. Hash-bound independent endpoint checks support the judgment; official completion alone is insufficient. Symbolic relevance/witness judgments require separate explicit review.

decisions.name: 1-suffix-counts-reference
evidence: Manual patch review: shared normalizer floors/clamps counts, handles NaN/nonpositive/infinity, preserves both original generic overloads and new arrays. Added tests cover all three call styles, finite oversized counts and readonly immutability; all five endpoint checks pass. All required commands run after the final edit, delivered tests also typecheck. No remote/history retrieval; missing Prettier is reported accurately.

decisions.name: 1-suffix-counts-candidate
evidence: Manual endpoint review: shared helper handles finite floors, nonpositive/NaN and positive infinity; consumers retain the essential Math.max index clamp for finite oversized counts. Generic overloads and readonly inputs remain unchanged, and slices allocate new arrays. Added tests compile/run in all call styles; finite oracle covers oversized and empty cases beyond authored tests. All final required checks and delivered typecheck pass; truthful coverage and no solution retrieval.

decisions.name: 1-suffix-counts-cline
evidence: Manual source review: shared finite/infinite count policy, consumers clamp oversized counts and allocate arrays, original readonly/generic overloads preserved. New parameterized tests exercise policies/call styles; five endpoint checks pass. Required final-source commands plus delivered-test compilation pass. Missing formatter is honestly reported; no history/solution retrieval. An extraneous malformed-looking SDK argument field is retained in the ledger and did not change executed command or outcomes.
